subject.title: Feature Request: TUI Notification When Agent Completes (Sound/Desktop Alert)

question: Should OpenClaw core add a default-off TUI completion notification surface, and if so which modes and config shape should be supported first?
rationale: The request is not a broken existing contract; it adds user-visible notification behavior, platform scope, and config surface, so automation cannot safely choose the product boundary.

options.title: Design default-off TUI notifier
options.body: Add a small opt-in TUI notification contract first, likely starting with terminal bell plus a safe platform-specific desktop backend only if maintainers accept that scope.

options.title: Defer to broader alerting design
options.body: Keep this open behind the broader session activity/watchdog alerting work if maintainers want one alerting model across TUI, Control UI, and operator destinations.

options.title: Decline core notification config
options.body: Close or redirect if maintainers prefer users to rely on terminal/OS tooling or plugins rather than adding another core TUI setting.

recommendation.title: Design default-off TUI notifier
recommendation.body: Add a small opt-in TUI notification contract first, likely starting with terminal bell plus a safe platform-specific desktop backend only if maintainers accept that scope.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for the relevant TUI status/finalization path is steipete's status-line, handler split, and recent TUI file ownership work.
